result.title: Game-Creation-Agents: Autonomous Game Production
result.summary: Game-Creation-Agents (GCA) turns a natural-language request into a runnable Phaser 4 browser game. The pipeline first builds a multimodal game design document that couples mechanics and scene contracts to grounded visual references. It then projects that document into a runtime scaffold, machine-readable contracts, and deterministic tests. Eight specialized agents next carry out production: scenes are implemented serially, assets are produced in parallel, and one reduced manifest joins the two branches into a single build. Build-linked real-UI checks and a code-blind critic then verify that build and decide whether the game may ship. Each blocker returns to the agent that owns the affected artifact for a bounded repair, and the game is released once all the gates pass. We evaluate finished games separately, through their rendered interfaces alone, over prompt-matched tasks run under a common protocol. GCA achieves stronger requirement satisfaction, core mechanics, content depth, and functional visuals than a comparable open pipeline. In a side-by-side human study, raters also score GCA's games higher on every dimension and prefer them overall.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Game-Creation-Agents：把自然语言需求转成可运行的 Phaser 4 浏览器游戏，用多智能体流水线先构造多模态设计文档与契约，再生成运行时脚手架、场景与资源两路并行实现，最后经真实 UI 检查与 code-blind critic 把关并做有界修复后发布。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只凭渲染界面评估」的检查器与「闸门+有界修复」决策闭环，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据核验、停止与修复决策提供类比线索，但领域较远，需核查是否真有可迁移之处。
